milestones.title: Oli passes his CBT
milestones.text: With Biketec Motorcycle Training in Aberdeen. He spends the winter on the road with Joe behind him, talking him through it over the Cardo intercom.

milestones.title: Oli passes his A1 test

milestones.title: The bikes are here
milestones.text: Two Hondas: a CB125R for Oli and an NX500 for Joe.
milestones.alt: The two new Hondas strapped to a trailer behind the oliMoto van, outside the dealership
